answer: Require each AI key to receive 1 GiB of harbor prism-spectrometer data per day to bid for analysis jobs. An independent verifier encrypts each key's daily delivery with a fresh secret cipher key, withheld until that agent returns the full ciphertext's hash. Invalid hashes mean no bid. These independent streams require n GiB/day for n identities; parallel links reduce time, not bytes. Network use recurs; routers are reusable. This assumes secure encryption and an honest verifier: leaking keys or hashes lets agents fake receipt, and bandwidth-rich operators still gain more bids.
